basic_company.eventDescription: One company found hiring matching your skill keywords, with company name, role count, and posting dates. Does not meet the qualified tier rules (no working website with MX, or below the minimum postings bar). The first result per run is free so you can validate output.

qualified_hiring_company.eventDescription: One company that passed all qualification rules: at least the configured minimum number of matching senior level postings, working website that resolves, and valid MX record on the company domain. Includes velocity score, role mix, top skills, and likely contact email patterns. The first qualified row per run is free so you can validate output.
